spec_case: DESIGN.md §7.3 (M1-D2's own IGNORECASE expansion: Turkish dotless/dotted I)
description: CPython folds i/I/ı(U+0131)/İ(U+0130) together under IGNORECASE (confirmed directly against _sre.unicode_tolower plus re._casefix._EXTRA_CASES). fancy-regex's own Unicode case folding keeps the Turkish dotless 'ı' apart from plain ASCII 'I', so this translator expands the four code points into an explicit alternation itself rather than relying on the engine's own 'i' flag here -- an ordinary parity case, not a divergence (#479's settled question: expand where possible).
